newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Kuk to buy Central Banking shares.
newsitem.headline: Dong Kuk to buy Central Banking shares.

text.p: Dong Kuk Steel Mill Co said on Friday its board of directors had approved a plan to buy 10 percent of Central Banking Corp shares in the open market to raise its stake in the group.
Dong Kuk already holds the largest single stake of 17.25 percent in Central Banking, Dong Kuk said in a statement filed with the Korea Stock Exchange.
The plan is subject to approval at a shareholders' meeting of Central Banking scheduled on May 28.
If approved, Dong Kuk plans to buy 1.02 million of Central's shares within the next three months, the statement said.
